sources.title: vovaRL (V S) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Also needs Voyage AI (optional, but highly recommended for quality paper analysis). The workflow is: you give the agent a research question (or topic/direction), it pulls papers from papers-with-code and arxiv, reranks them and picks top-15 (with Voyage), then it makes a research plan, writes pipelines (with tests, preflight checks, smoke-runs).
